description: Address code review issues: fix genetic crossover gene ordering, fix repairAndEvaluate capacity/type bypass, gate AIR/SinDocente fallbacks on config flags, add LIMIT to ejecuciones endpoint, remove unused import.
steps: In genetico.ts: Sort genes by (unidadIdx, sesionIdx) before crossover so positional correspondence is guaranteed across individuals.
In genetico.ts: Fix repairAndEvaluate to look up the actual espacio from the espacios list (passed as a parameter) for non-AIR genes, passing real capacity and espacio object to isValid.
In engine.ts (iterative), greedy.ts, and genetico.ts: Gate AIR fallback attempts on config.permitirAIR and Sin Docente fallback attempts on config.permitirSinDocente.
In genetico.ts: Remove unused cloneOccupancyState import.
In ejecuciones/route.ts: Add LIMIT 50 to the query.
acceptance_criteria: Genetic crossover operates on genes sorted by (unidadIdx, sesionIdx) ensuring positional alignment
repairAndEvaluate validates capacity and type using actual espacio objects
AIR and SinDocente fallbacks are gated by config.permitirAIR and config.permitirSinDocente respectively
Ejecuciones endpoint has a LIMIT clause
verification: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` in project root and confirm 0 errors
findings: All 5 review issues addressed. TypeScript compilation passes with 0 errors. The genetic crossover now sorts genes by identity before splicing, repairAndEvaluate uses actual espacio objects for capacity/type/school validation, all three algorithms respect permitirAIR and permitirSinDocente config flags (with practicas always allowed to use AIR), ejecuciones endpoint capped at 50 results, and unused import removed.
